MapLibre GL JS 6.9.1, locally hosted with its shared module, worker and CSS.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/maplibre-gl/-/maplibre-gl-6.9.1.tgz
License and bundled notices: LICENSE.txt (BSD-3-Clause and included dependencies).
The npm SHA-512 integrity was verified before copying these release files.
See manifest.json for version, source and SHA-256 file hashes.

The local ../../origin-map-style.json is adapted from OpenFreeMap's Dark style,
downloaded on 2026-09-14 from https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark.
Changes: blue/green palette with brighter labels and roads, Inter font and
16 CSS px minimum labels, local web-font rendering instead of hosted glyphs.
Style and design notices: OPENFREEMAP-STYLE-LICENSE.txt.
Upstream: https://github.com/hyperknot/openfreemap-styles
Map data/design attribution: OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles, OpenStreetMap contributors.
The dashboard visibly attributes these providers next to the map.

Inter and its license are in ../../fonts/. Tiles and sprites are requested
directly from OpenFreeMap; these files contain no API key or selected origin.
